english.title: Operator fail to make amendments / additions to operations manual as CAA require
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the operator of public transport aircraft registered in the UK, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), failed to make such amendments or additions to the operations manual namely **(..SPECIFY AMENDMENT OR ADDITION..) as the CAA required for the purpose of ensuring the safety of the aircraft, or of persons or property carried in it, or for the safety, efficiency or regularity of air navigation
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 116(9) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
